article.headline: Olson scores 22, Dudley 21 and No. 2 Michigan women roll over Toledo 102-56
article.description: — Olivia Olson scored 22 points, Kendall Dudley had 21 and No. 2 Michigan cruised past Toledo 102-56 at the Baha Mar Pink Flamingo Championship on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Olson scores 22, Dudley 21 and No. 2 Michigan women roll over Toledo 102-56
article.story: NASSAU, Bahamas -- — Olivia Olson scored 22 points, Kendall Dudley had 21 and No. 2 Michigan cruised past Toledo 102-56 at the Baha Mar Pink Flamingo Championship on Wednesday. Syla Swords had 15 points, nine rebounds and five assists for Michigan. Te’Yala Delfosse scored 17 and Dallas Loughridge had 11 points and seven assists. Dudley added six rebounds and five assists. Michigan improved to 7-0 and is closing in on the program record of 10 straight wins to open a season, accomplished in 2020-21. The Wolverines scored 10 points in the last 2 1/2 minutes of the first quarter, building a 36-15 lead. Toledo kept pace in the second quarter and Michigan lead 54-34 at halftime. The Wolverines were dominant in the first four minutes after halftime. Dudley and Swords scored six points each in a 16-2 run that made it 70-36. The Wolverines scored 31 points in the third quarter, extending their lead to 85-48. Michigan had a 17-8 advantage in the fourth quarter. Michigan shot 64% overall, including 36 of 51 on two-pointers and 7 of 16 on 3s. Toledo (4-3) was held to 33% shooting. The Rockets' leading scorer was Destiny Robinson with nine points. Up next Toledo: The Rockets play at Milwaukee on Sunday. Michigan: The Wolverines host Southern Indiana on Monday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full college basketball coverage here.
